title: Product Discovery Criteria
description: Structured criteria shared by product listing and proposal requests. Offer filters decide which commercial offers may be returned; targeting_overlay constrains deliverable inventory; required_overlay_support requires package-level targeting capability for values the buyer will supply later; acceptance_context supplies facts for advisory seller-policy preflight.

product_ids.description: Exact seller-issued products to retrieve or use as proposal candidates.

product_ids_exclusive.description: When true, product_ids is the complete composable product universe for this request rather than a candidate hint: every proposal purchase, and every product echoed alongside proposals, MUST reference a listed product_id. A seller that cannot satisfy the brief within the universe returns the rejected outcome (request_proposals) or a partial/unable result with reason constraint_unsatisfiable (refine_proposals); it never returns off-universe products or purchases. Requires product_ids. Sellers that do not declare media_buy.supports_exclusive_product_ids in get_adcp_capabilities MUST NOT silently ignore this flag — they reject the request at task level with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.

offer_filters.description: Hard commercial and product-characteristic filters. Every returned product MUST satisfy them. These fields do not become package delivery targeting.

targeting_overlay.description: Concrete delivery constraints the buyer expects to carry into create_media_buy. Returned product pricing and forecasts MUST reflect the effective targeting. A product that cannot apply the request exactly is omitted or returned as a distinct configured product with sparse Product.targeting_resolution modifications; absence of that resolution means exact acceptance.

required_overlay_support.description: Minimum product-scoped targeting dimensions the buyer must be able to select independently on packages later. This requests capability, not current values, value-specific availability, a forecast for every later value, or one product per value.

acceptance_context.description: Structured campaign and advertiser facts for coarse acceptance-policy matching. A matching product is not a guarantee of final acceptance.
